records.applicability_gate: NOT_PASSED: a spike train of a one-neuron model is not an episode of a bearer; spikes, firing counts and the body's fall are not inputs of any attribution (R37: Det_D, not Occ_G)
records.coupling: OPEN LOOP: the body ran first; the neuron's spikes are not an input of the body (XenoSNN keeps no state between calls and cannot be closed-loop with a body)

encoding.signal: the body's sensed vestibular trunk-tilt estimate (the controller's own delayed, noisy copy; XB-TRO sensed channel 2n, n = 4 links)
encoding.status: STIPULATED. No value of the gain was tuned to any result; another encoding is another experiment

records.memory: NONE in the neuron; the body's slow gain adaptation is part of the body's own run and is not recorded here

operational_summary.reading: a listing of two groups, not a test and not a measure of anything but this encoding; a difference between the groups would be an operational difference of a stipulated signal, not a Gaisho

records.weights: NONE: XenoSNN is one LIF neuron with fixed beta and threshold, set in its code
